page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s6-c1m2.small is an entry-level virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.s6 server family. Powered by the KVM hypervisor, this instance features a single shared vCPU based on the x86_64 architecture. The physical processor is an Intel Xeon 8269CY running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz, configured with one physical core and one thread. It is equipped with 2.0 GB of system memory, providing a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio.

This instance does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through attached network block storage. The baseline network bandwidth is rated at 0 Gbps, and the instance does not come with complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Given the shared CPU allocation and minimal resource footprint, this instance is designed for high resource density and qualitative cost efficiency, offering a low-cost entry point for workloads that do not require dedicated CPU resources or high-speed networking.

The ecs.s6-c1m2.small is suited for lightweight, non-critical workloads. Appropriate use cases include simple web serving, development and testing environments, low-traffic microservices, and basic utility scripting where continuous high CPU utilization is not required.
